name: The Absent Minded Prospector
summary: From Darkshore, Hollee sends Remtravel’s fossil to Darnassus while she stays to watch the wandering prospector. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker takes a keen interest in the find.

sections.title: A Courier to the Capital
sections.body: Prospector Remtravel has found a curious fossil on Darkshore’s coast. He would rather keep digging than follow protocol. So Archaeologist Hollee stays with him among the shore’s dangerous beasts and hostile cultists. She asks you to carry the specimen to Darnassus, where a dwarven scholarly delegation is kept.

sections.title: The Dwarven Stake in Kalimdor
sections.body: Dwarves from Ironforge have crossed the Great Sea under the Explorers’ League banner. They seek ancient relics and lost history in Kalimdor’s soil. In Darnassus, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker marvels at Remtravel’s knack for finding ancient treasures. Night elves see their forests as living sanctuaries, while the League sees ancient lands as ground to study and decipher.

faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel found an unidentified petrified specimen on Darkshore’s coast. Its age and strange nature make it a prized find for Explorers’ League scholars in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why does Hollee stay behind in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Archaeologist Hollee stays to watch Prospector Remtravel. He wanders off and ignores danger while excavating, so she will not leave him alone in the wilds while she carries his discoveries to Darnassus.

Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker is a senior representative of Ironforge’s Explorers’ League. He oversees archaeological work in northern Kalimdor from Darnassus, where he studies relics brought back by dwarven diggers.

faq.q: Why is the Explorers' League operating in Darnassus?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard chartered the Explorers’ League to uncover the origins of the dwarven race and ancient history across Azeroth. Friendly ties with the night elves let dwarven scholars base expeditions in Darnassus and study Kalimdor’s forgotten lands.

faq.q: Where does this fossil end up after Darnassus?
faq.answer: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker inspects the fossil in Darnassus. Finds of this scale are meant to be cataloged or sent through League channels toward the great museum in Ironforge.

faq.q: Where did Remtravel find the specimen?
faq.answer: Remtravel uncovered the specimen on Darkshore’s wild coast, among shipwrecks, ancient ruins, and fossilized sea life from before the Great Sundering.

angles.text: As a dwarf, carrying Remtravel’s fossil serves the Explorers’ League’s chief aim: uncovering the world’s deep past and showing the worth of dwarven perseverance.
As a night elf, seeing dwarven excavators bring ancient remnants from Darkshore’s sacred soil can be jarring. Cooperation with the League preserves Alliance bonds.
As an Alliance member, you help connect its people across great distances. Dwarven researchers rely on travelers to carry finds safely from Darkshore’s remote shores to Darnassus.
